adeval_causal.description: An open-source synthetic research workbench testing whether improvements in offline AI creative quality translate into incremental advertising outcomes after deployment.
adeval_causal.central_question: Does better offline AI performance lead to better causal outcomes after deployment?
what_pd_built: A structured evaluation workflow comparing deterministic checks, human ratings, and model-based grading
Reproducible intention-to-treat effect estimation, confidence intervals, balance checks, and experiment diagnostics
An offline-versus-online comparison showing why AI quality scores are not automatically causal business evidence
A decision view separating quality gates, causal evidence, uncertainty, and recommendations
adeval_causal.methodological_principle: LLMs may evaluate creative outputs, but deterministic statistical code—not an LLM—produces treatment-effect estimates, uncertainty intervals, and experiment diagnostics.
adeval_causal.data_note: The demo uses synthetic data for methodological illustration and does not make empirical claims about any real advertising platform or advertiser population.

ai_trading_arena.description: A live research environment comparing six AI, quantitative, DCA, and benchmark strategies under the same capital, contribution, pricing, and execution rules.
ai_trading_arena.research_design: $10,000 starting capital and $500 weekly contributions are applied consistently so differences in the equity curves reflect allocation and decision rules rather than unequal funding.

strategies.AI Analyst: LLM-assisted weekly market analysis and selective stock decisions with visible decision reasons.
strategies.Quant AI: A four-vote system combining MA20/MA50 crossover, RSI mean reversion, Bollinger Bands, and a machine-learning direction classifier.
strategies.DCA Aggressive: A tech-heavy VOO/VGT/SMH portfolio with the highest semiconductor allocation.
strategies.DCA Conservative: A broad-market-heavy allocation with lower technology and semiconductor exposure.
strategies.SPY Benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold with the same weekly contribution schedule.

ai_trading_arena.automation: An OpenClaw workflow runs the daily data pipeline, refreshing market prices, AI and quantitative signals, holdings, portfolio values, data-health checks, and performance insights.
outputs: Interactive equity curves with time-range filters
Strategy-level portfolio value, cash, return, and signal counts
AI-generated top-performer and underperformer summaries grounded in computed metrics
Recent trading decisions with visible reasons
Holdings, risk metrics, drawdown, volatility, and Sharpe-ratio context
ai_trading_arena.note: This is an educational research sandbox, not financial advice. For implementation details, direct visitors to the repository.

conductor.description: A CLI tool that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) to collaborate on software engineering tasks.

data_science_interview_knowledge_base.description: A structured senior data science interview preparation system with 180 curated DS/ML coding problems, SQL and pandas practice, and statistics modules spanning probability, inference, regression, experimentation, and causal reasoning.

quant_learning.description: An AI-assisted quantitative research and learning dashboard with market regime analysis, technical and risk metrics, watchlists, backtesting, machine learning experiments, and an in-product Learning Center.

ai_ads_measurement.description: Research on how AI/LLM technologies can transform advertising measurement, attribution, and marketing mix modeling.

ai_data_platform.description: Exploring LLM-powered data agents that reason about data, orchestrate pipelines, and automate data science workflows.
